contentBlocks.title: Approved — When Will You Be Paid?
contentBlocks.description: Your SASSA grant has been approved! Understand what 'Approved' status means, when your payment will arrive, how long it takes to reflect in your bank account, and what to do if your payment is delayed.

contentBlocks.text: Approved — What It Means for Your SASSA Grant

An 'Approved' status is exactly what you have been waiting for. It means SASSA has completed its verification checks, confirmed that you meet the eligibility criteria for the month, and allocated funds for your payment. This is the final clearance before your money is sent to your bank or collection point.
This status is for SASSA beneficiaries whose grant applications have been successfully reviewed and approved for payment.

contentBlocks.title: Your Grant Is Approved
contentBlocks.text: Payments are processed according to the official SASSA payment schedule. Funds typically reflect 1-3 business days after the pay date.

contentBlocks.explanation: Your application passed all verification checks: identity matched Home Affairs records, bank details were successfully verified, means test showed no disqualifying income, and no fraud flags were raised. SASSA has now included you in the payment batch for the current month.
whyItHappens: All eligibility criteria have been satisfied
Identity verification passed against Home Affairs database
Means test confirmed your income is within the threshold
No UIF, NSFAS, or other funding sources were detected
contentBlocks.howLongItLasts: The 'Approved' status lasts until the payment is processed and transferred to your bank or collection agent. Once paid, the status updates to 'Payment Processing' or 'Paid'. Every new month is evaluated separately — approval one month does not guarantee approval the next.
whatYouShouldDo: Check for a pay date alongside your approved status
If receiving bank transfer: expect funds in 1 to 3 business days after the pay date
If receiving Cash Send: wait for the SMS voucher before visiting a retailer
Do not close or change your bank account until after the payment arrives
Continue checking your status at the start of each new month for re-evaluation
whatToCheck: Check whether a specific payment date is shown under the approved month badge.
Confirm your payment method: bank deposit vs cash send collection.
Verify that the registered bank account belongs to you and matches your ID document spelling.

contentBlocks.text: Approved Without a Pay Date — What It Means and What to Do

If your status shows 'Approved' but no pay date appears next to it, your application is approved for this month, but a pay day has not been shown yet. This happens regularly and does not mean your approval has been withdrawn. In most cases the pay date is added as the next payment run approaches.

contentBlocks.title: Approved but no pay date showing?
contentBlocks.text: Your application is approved, but a pay day has not been displayed yet. Nothing is required from you while you wait — keep checking your status every few days rather than reapplying.

This is different from 'Pending', which means SASSA is still assessing your eligibility for this month. It is also different from a payment that has gone missing: if a pay date was shown and that date has passed with no money in your account, follow our payment not reflecting guide instead.
What NOT to Do While Waiting

items: Do not submit a new application — it will not make a pay date appear sooner and can complicate your existing record
Do not pay anyone who claims they can release your payment or force a pay date to show — this is a common scam
Do not repeatedly change your banking details while waiting — each change restarts verification and can push your payment into the next cycle
Do not rely only on SMS notifications — check your status directly on the official portal

contentBlocks.text: No SMS Yet? Why That May Be Normal

Approval notifications are sent by SMS where SASSA has a working cellphone number on file, but messages can arrive late or not at all — especially if your number changed since you applied. The status portal is the reliable source of truth: if it shows 'Approved', treat your grant as approved whether or not an SMS arrived. If your number has changed or been lost, update it using our SRD phone number guide so future notifications reach you.
Illustrative example: approved, then paid two days later

Nomsa's Older Persons Grant changed to Approved, and the portal showed the pay date for her grant category next to the month badge. Because her grant is paid by bank transfer into her own account, the money appeared the working day after that date rather than on it. Had she chosen a cash-send collection, the sequence would have been different: she would have waited for a voucher SMS before going to a retailer.

Two weeks later her status still read Approved but with no pay date for the new month. That is the normal in-between state — approval for a month is recorded before the national payment file for that month is finalised. It becomes a problem worth acting on only when the published pay date for her category has passed and nothing has arrived.

contentBlocks.text: Where pay dates and amounts are published

Grant amounts and the annual payment schedule are published by SASSA at sassa.gov.za, and payments for permanent grants are disbursed through Postbank and the commercial banks. The pay date shown against your own approved month on the SRD portal is the authoritative date for your record; the calendar on this site reproduces the published national schedule and is dated so you can see when it was last checked.
Frequently Asked Questions

faqs.question: My status says 'Approved' but there is no pay date. What does this mean?
faqs.answer: Your application is approved, but a pay day has not been shown yet. This happens regularly and nothing is required from your side. A pay date is usually added within a few business days as the next payment run approaches — keep checking your status rather than reapplying.

faqs.question: Can an 'Approved' status change back to 'Pending' or 'Declined'?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every month is evaluated as a separate cycle. If your financial situation changes mid-month (e.g., you receive a bank deposit), the next month may show a different status.

faqs.question: I am approved but the money is not in my account. What should I do?
faqs.answer: Wait 1 to 3 business days after the pay date. If it still does not appear, check that your bank details are correct and that the account is active. If the issue continues, contact SASSA.

faqs.question: Do I need to reapply every month if I was approved?
faqs.answer: No. Once you are approved, your grant is automatically evaluated each month. You only need to reapply if your grant was cancelled or you need to switch grant types.

faqs.question: Can I change my payment method after approval?
faqs.answer: Yes. Log into the SRD portal and go to 'Payment Method' to switch between bank transfer and Cash Send. Changes take effect from the next month.
